message: Hey John, I've been feeling really anxious lately and I'm not sure how to deal with it. My baby has gone due to an accident - there is no way to make up for this. Haven't talked to Mark about this yet, but I needed to tell someone.
John, have you noticed Sarah being a bit off recently? I'm getting worried.
Can't wait for the art exhibit at Riverdale Gallery next weekend! It's going to be such a nice break from everything.
Hey buddy, do you think the Riverdale Gallery exhibit is worth a visit?
I'm so glad I have you to talk to, John. It's been tough, but I'm trying to stay positive.
Sarah seems to be in her own world lately, not sure what's up. Any ideas?
I've been doing some painting to help with my anxiety. It's actually quite therapeutic.
John, Sarah mentioned you might go to the Riverdale Gallery. If you go, let me know how it is!
I'm looking forward to our gallery trip. It's been a while since I've done something just for me.
Is everything okay with Sarah? She's been acting differently and I'm not sure why.
